issue_context.title: Wrong localization on countdown buttons in multiplayer room
issue_context.body:
### Type

Other

### Bug description

The buttons used to start a match after some time are wrongly localized.
I attached a screenshot from my friend, as this bug happens only to him. He has both Windows and osu! in English.

### Screenshots or videos

![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/63348037/82d1bd24-b472-4de0-84f6-e84783b91230)


### Version
